related_questions.snippet: The advantages of telehealth include convenience, generally lower costs, and more consistent management of medical conditions. related_questions.question: Has Medicare telehealth used increase during the pandemic?
related_questions.snippet: Prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, telehealth utilization in traditional Medicare was very low, but it rose dramatically in 2020 following temporary measures put in place at the start of the COVID-19 public health emergency that greatly expanded the scope of Medicare coverage of telehealth.
